subject: E-Commerce
title: Micro-Fulfillment Centers
description: A short lesson to help you apply Micro-Fulfillment Centers.

hook.text: Micro-fulfillment centers are mini warehouses inside cities, sometimes in basement parking lots or old retail stores.

buildup.text: Being close to customers means same-day or even one-hour delivery. Distance is the enemy of speed.

discovery.text: Fabric and AutoStore build robotic MFCs that fit in 10,000 sqft—100x smaller than traditional warehouses.

twist.text: Walmart converts the back of existing stores into MFCs. Retail space becomes fulfillment space after hours.

climax.text: Micro-fulfillment makes speed affordable. Small, automated, and close beats big, distant, and fast.

punchline.text: 10,000 sqft in a parking garage. Tiny automated warehouses are the speed secret.

quiz.question: What is a micro-fulfillment center?
options: A compact automated warehouse located close to customers in urban areas
